q: What UK label was bought by the broadcast company that, along with ABC and the original network of Undercovers, is one of the major broadcasters based in New York?

traj.q: major broadcast networks based in New York ABC CBS NBC

Explanation: The television series *Undercovers* aired on NBC [1]. The three major American broadcast networks headquartered in New York City are ABC, CBS, and NBC [3]. The question asks for the UK label bought by the broadcast company that is one of these three major networks (along with ABC and NBC). The documents indicate that CBS (Columbia Broadcasting System) acquired Oriole Records in 1964 to establish its own UK distribution [2].
